name: Security Log Source Coverage and Retention Configuration
description: Which in-scope components send security-relevant logs to the central store, how long those logs are retained, and what protects them from alteration.

expected_content.element: List of log sources actively forwarding, with last-received time per source
expected_content.why: A configured source that stopped forwarding is functionally absent, and only last-received time distinguishes them.

expected_content.element: Authoritative asset inventory for the same date, reconciled against the source list
expected_content.why: The platform's own source list always looks complete; the inventory is the only honest denominator.

expected_content.element: Retention period configured per source or index
expected_content.why: Retention shorter than the examination period leaves an interval that cannot be evidenced at all.

expected_content.element: Log integrity or immutability configuration, where implemented
expected_content.why: Determines whether records of an incident could be altered by the access that caused it.

expected_content.element: Coverage of identity, infrastructure, application, and endpoint sources
expected_content.why: Partial-domain coverage is common and produces monitoring blind to whole classes of activity.

source_system_examples: SIEM data source and index configuration

freshness_expectation.rationale: DriftGuard default for a continuously enforced configuration. Not an audit rule.

redaction_guidance: Source names may identify systems; retain enough to reconcile to the inventory.
Do not include log contents in a coverage artifact.
retention_guidance: Capture on a schedule and retain dated snapshots alongside EV-CONFIG-001, since this is point-in-time evidence.

validation_rules.rule: A log source and retention configuration export exists.
Forwarding sources reconcile to the authoritative asset inventory for the same date.
Configured retention is at least as long as the examination period.
For a Type 2 conclusion the export is paired with EV-CONFIG-001 covering the period.
The export comes from the logging platform's API rather than a maintained list.
Log integrity protection is described where the entity claims it.

common_issues.issue: Sources configured but silently stopped forwarding mid-period.
common_issues.impact: Monitoring appears complete while an interval has no telemetry at all.

common_issues.issue: Retention set to a platform default shorter than the examination period.
common_issues.impact: Early months of the period cannot be evidenced regardless of what was collected.

common_issues.issue: Coverage limited to infrastructure, with identity and application sources absent.
common_issues.impact: Whole classes of activity are outside detection.

source_refs.supports: Expected content, persuasiveness weighting, and the common issues list.
Freshness window, sensitivity classification, and redaction guidance.

notes: The criteria name no retention period. Adequacy is assessed against the entity's own examination period, not an external benchmark.
